name: Introduction to Statistical Reasoning
syllabus_body:
An introduction to describing data and reasoning with probability.

Learning Objectives

By the end of the course you will be able to:

  1. S1 — Summarise data with appropriate measures of centre and spread.
  2. S2 — Compute and interpret basic probabilities.

Schedule

  • Week 2: Describing Data
  • Week 3: Probability
